006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library.FnDoc;
010
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012
013/**
014 * FODC: Exceptions representing document related errors.
015 */
016public class DocumentFunctionException
017    extends FunctionMetapathError {
018  @NonNull
019  private static final String PREFIX = "FODC";
020  /**
021   * <a href=
022   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFODC0002">err:FODC0002</a>:
023   * Raised by {@link FnDoc}, fn:collection, and fn:uri-collection to indicate
024   * that either the supplied URI cannot be dereferenced to obtain a resource, or
025   * the resource that is returned is not parseable as XML.
026   */
027  public static final int ERROR_RETRIEVING_RESOURCE = 2;
028  /**
029   * <a href=
030   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFODC0003">err:FODC0003</a>:
031   * Raised by {@link FnDoc}, fn:collection, and fn:uri-collection to indicate
032   * that it is not possible to return a result that is guaranteed deterministic.
033   */
034  public static final int FUNCTION_NOT_DEFINED_AS_DETERMINISTIC = 3;
035  /**
036   * <a href=
037   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFODC0002">err:FODC0002</a>:
038   * Raised (optionally) by {@link FnDoc} and fn:doc-available if the argument is
039   * not a valid URI reference.
040   */
041  public static final int INVALID_ARGUMENT = 5;
042
043  /**
044   * the serial version UID.
045   */
046  private static final long serialVersionUID = 2L;
047
048  /**
049   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
050   * and no cause.
051   *
052   * @param code
053   *          the error code value
054   * @param message
055   *          the exception message
056   */
057  public DocumentFunctionException(int code, String message) {
058    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message);
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
063   * and {@code cause}.
064   *
065   * @param code
066   *          the error code value
067   * @param message
068   *          the exception message
069   * @param cause
070   *          the original exception cause
071   */
072  public DocumentFunctionException(int code, String message, Throwable cause) {
073    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message, cause);
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, no message, and
078   * the {@code cause}.
079   *
080   * @param code
081   *          the error code value
082   * @param cause
083   *          the original exception cause
084   */
085  public DocumentFunctionException(int code, Throwable cause) {
086    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), cause);
087  }
088}
